subject: Request: security testing artifacts + CAIQ evidence for procurement - Redwood
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira@orionhealth.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: grc-portal@orionhealth.com
Date: Mon, 05 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: penetration testing artifacts + CAIQ evidence for Redwood — Orion Health procurement

Hi Markus,

Procurement / InfoSec at Orion is preparing the final security review for Redwood before we move to legal. Two items are required in our SIG/CAIQ workflow: 1) the most recent penetration test report (redaction allowed for customer data) and 2) a remediation attestation that lists open/high findings and their planned closure dates.

We'd like the artifacts uploaded to our GRC portal (see instructions attached) and a simple CSV mapping showing which CAIQ questions are satisfied by the pen test (where the questionnaire links to the report). Our deadline is Friday 9/10 EOD Pacific to stay on cadence — is that feasible?

Attachments: Orion_GRC_upload_instructions.pdf

If you prefer to send a signed attestation instead of entering content into the portal, that is acceptable as long as the portal shows the file and your attest ID.

Thanks,
Samira Patel
Sr. Security Program Manager
Orion Health
From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Samira Patel <samira@orionhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: penetration testing artifacts + CAIQ evidence for Redwood — Orion Health procurement

Samira —

Thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. A few clarifying items so we provide exactly what you need:

- Scope: do you require the full technical report with all low/med findings, or only executive/high+critical details? We can provide a fully redacted report that keeps vulnerability IDs and descriptions but removes customer-specific data.
- Attestation: is a signed attestation letter sufficient for your remediation requirement, or do you need per-finding closure dates in the portal?
- Portal: I don't currently have an upload account for ORN-4312 — can you confirm the user id or invite markus.klein@redwood.com to the portal?

Proposed timeline if we get portal access and confirmation on redaction:
- Redacted report upload: 3 business days
- CAIQ mapping CSV: same day as upload
- Remediation tracker (per-finding): 5 business days

We'll route the report and the tracker through our security redaction process (Vanessa and Mina are copied) so we can include a short attestation statement signed by our Head of Security.

If Friday 9/10 is firm, we'll prioritize the redacted report first and follow up with the tracker.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Sales Engineering (on security special requests)
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Sep 5, 2027 at 10:03 AM, markus.klein@redwood.com wrote:
> Markus —
> 
> Thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. A few clarifying items so we provide exactly what you need:
> 
> - Scope: do you require the full technical report with all low/med findings, or only executive/high+critical details?

We need high+critical findings and any findings that remain open > 90 days. Low/med that are closed can be summarized in the tracker. A fully redacted PDF is fine — please retain the vulnerability IDs, affected component, and remediation notes.

Portal: invite sent to markus.klein@redwood.com for ORN-4312; upload link: https://grc.orionhealth.com/uploads/ORN-4312

Attached: CAIQ_required_sections.csv (list of CAIQ sections that reference penetration testing evidence) and GRC_upload_instructions.pdf

Please also include a short statement confirming that the redaction process removed customer data only and that findings were not altered.

Thanks — looking forward to the upload.
Samira
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Samira Patel <samira@orionhealth.com>, markus.klein@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Upload: redacted pen test + remediation tracker (ORN-4312)

Samira / Orion team —

Forwarding final deliverables and status. Per Markus's ask, Security completed redaction and validation. Deliverables uploaded to your portal and to our shared drive.

Summary of actions completed:
- Uploaded redacted report: Redwood-Redacted-Pentest-2027-09.pdf (GRC ticket ORN-4312-REDACT)
- Uploaded remediation tracker CSV: remediation-tracker-orion-20270908.csv (includes columns: finding_id, severity, status, first_reported, planned_close_date, owner)
- CAIQ mapping: embedded in the tracker (column: caiq_section) and attached as CAIQ_required_sections.csv to the portal entry
- Attestation: "Redwood Inference confirms the attached redacted penetration test report has been redacted only to remove customer-identifying data. The remediation tracker reflects the current status of open findings as of 2027-09-08. Signed attestation is attached in the portal entry."

Open items (short):
- Two high findings (RID-2027-H1, RID-2027-H2): mitigation in progress, planned close dates 2027-10-03 and 2027-09-24 respectively.
- One medium finding older than 90 days (RID-2027-M7): scheduled for remediation 2027-10-15; note included in the tracker with justification.

Attachments (delivered to portal): Redwood-Redacted-Pentest-2027-09.pdf; remediation-tracker-orion-20270908.csv; CAIQ_required_sections.csv

If you want a signed PDF attestation, we can push a DocuSign envelope — let me know and we'll route to our Head of Security for signature.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
